decisions.decision: The read-only backend is selected per-LEG by ROLE, never per-EVENT
decisions.rationale: TRUST-05's asymmetry is a one-way ratchet -- a signal may only narrow RW->RO, never widen RO->RW. An event-derived read-only pull_request base could never be widened back for dogfood-seed, which asserts a hard PUT 200, so it would revert quick task 260801-vyy's CR-18 fix with no possible composition to restore it. Maintainer decision, 2026-08-02.
